# `assets/weapon/WeaponRig.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/weapon/WeaponRig.js`

engine/assets/weapon/WeaponRig.js — canonical weapon socket/part schema (spec §13). A weapon is a model + sockets (muzzle/chamber/grips/sight/…) + moving parts (slide/bolt/hammer/…) + a fire/reload timeline + a state machine. This is a GAME ABSTRACTION: sockets/timings are gameplay anchors, not real-firearm data. Every detection is a hint with confidence; ambiguous nodes go to the editor.
